missing_components.description: No workflows are defined to coordinate or automate sequences of activities.
No user interface modules are defined, which may prevent user interaction or monitoring.
No data tables are defined; there is no storage mechanism for entities or transactions.
No catalog items are defined, required for any catalog-based functionality.
No integrations are defined, potentially hindering communication with external systems.

risks.description: Lack of defined workflows and UIs may hinder automated operations and user interactions.
Absence of a data model could lead to challenges in data management and querying.

recommendations.action: Define essential workflows to link the processes, logic patterns, and events cohesively.
Develop UI modules to facilitate interaction and monitoring by users.
Establish a comprehensive data model with necessary tables for managing entities and records.
Identify and integrate necessary third-party systems to support external operations.
Review and populate catalog items to support internal catalog-based functions if needed.
